title: Fictional Maple Library pilot
content: FICTIONAL VALIDATION FIXTURE. Maple Library tested a repair cafe for three Saturdays. Volunteers repaired 18 of 30 small household items. Tables, safe electrical testing and a booking desk were needed. Attendance does not establish long-term demand. The pilot coordinator recommends monthly sessions.

title: Fictional community survey
content: FICTIONAL VALIDATION FIXTURE. A voluntary survey of 25 residents found 15 interested in a repair cafe, but only four willing to volunteer. Respondents preferred quarterly sessions until more volunteers are trained. The sample was self-selected; it does not represent every resident.
